WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.review_score, r.review_creation_date
  FROM reviews.order_reviews r
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
  JOIN orders.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'
    AND r.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL
),
window_agg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(review_score AS DOUBLE)), 4) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n_window
  FROM base
  WHERE review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND review_creation_date < DATE '2018-02-01'
),
baseline_agg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(review_score AS DOUBLE)), 4) AS baseline, COUNT(*) AS n_baseline
  FROM base
  WHERE review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND review_creation_date < DATE '2018-01-01'
)
SELECT value, baseline, n_window, n_baseline
FROM window_agg CROSS JOIN baseline_agg;
